The housing is dark, likely black metal, with prominent visors (hoods) over each lens. A mounting pole or bracket structure is visible on the left side, silhouetted against the sky.

Also, verify if the simultaneous illumination of Red and Amber is physically plausible (some systems do this for transition, but often it's an AI error combining states).
